MentalModel.name: MentalModel
MentalModel.description: The externalized representation of a developer's understanding of a codebase - contains domains, capabilities, aspects, and decisions

Domain.name: Domain
Domain.description: A core business concept (noun) - represents what exists in the system, has identity and lifecycle

Capability.name: Capability
Capability.description: An action the system performs (verb) - operates on domains, can compose other capabilities

Aspect.name: Aspect
Aspect.description: A cross-cutting concern - applies governance (auth, validation, retry) across multiple capabilities or domains

Decision.name: Decision
Decision.description: A recorded architectural choice with rationale - captures the 'why' behind system design, can be superseded

ModelEvent.name: ModelEvent
ModelEvent.description: An immutable record of a change to the mental model - enables event sourcing with full audit trail

AddEntity.name: AddEntity
AddEntity.description: Creates a new domain, capability, aspect, or decision in the mental model

UpdateEntity.name: UpdateEntity
UpdateEntity.description: Modifies an existing entity's properties with field-level change tracking

DeleteEntity.name: DeleteEntity
DeleteEntity.description: Removes an entity from the mental model

RenameEntity.name: RenameEntity
RenameEntity.description: Renames an entity with optional cascade to update all references

SupersedeDecision.name: SupersedeDecision
SupersedeDecision.description: Marks a decision as superseded and records the new decision with rationale

ShowModel.name: ShowModel
ShowModel.description: Displays the current mental model as formatted text in the terminal

VisualizeModel.name: VisualizeModel
VisualizeModel.description: Renders an interactive web-based visualization with entity selection, connection highlighting, and decision viewing

ReplayEvents.name: ReplayEvents
ReplayEvents.description: Reconstructs mental model state by replaying event log from storage

OnboardAgent.name: OnboardAgent
OnboardAgent.description: Injects mental model documentation into CLAUDE.md for AI agent context

EventSourcing.name: EventSourcing
EventSourcing.description: All mutations are recorded as immutable events - enables audit trail, time-travel, and reconstruction

Validation.name: Validation
Validation.description: Entity names, references, and relationships are validated before events are created

CascadeReferences.name: CascadeReferences
CascadeReferences.description: When entities are renamed or deleted, references from other entities can be automatically updated

InteractivePrompts.name: InteractivePrompts
InteractivePrompts.description: CLI commands use interactive prompts to guide users through multi-field input

dec-1768948436560.what: Event sourcing over direct state mutation
dec-1768948436560.why: Provides complete audit trail, enables time-travel to any point, supports undo/redo, and makes the model's evolution transparent

dec-1768948436728.what: Pure command functions in shared package
dec-1768948436728.why: Separates business logic from I/O - enables testing without filesystem, allows reuse across CLI and potential future APIs, makes commands composable

dec-1768948436874.what: Four entity types: Domain, Capability, Aspect, Decision
dec-1768948436874.why: Maps to natural language patterns - nouns (what exists), verbs (what it does), adverbs (how governed), and rationale (why). Simpler than UML, captures what matters for understanding

dec-1768948437017.what: Monorepo with cli, shared, web packages
dec-1768948437017.why: Clear separation of concerns - CLI handles I/O and user interaction, shared contains pure business logic, web provides visualization. Enables independent development and testing

dec-1768948437154.why: Human-readable, appendable, streamable - each event is one line, easy to inspect with standard tools, no need for database setup

dec-1768948437291.what: Embed web bundle in CLI for view command
dec-1768948437291.why: Zero external dependencies for visualization - user runs 'mental view' and gets instant local server. No npm install, no build step, just works

dec-1768976091873.what: Use Claude Code hooks for workflow integration
dec-1768976091873.why: Hooks provide lightweight, non-intrusive reminders at key moments (like pre-push) without injecting large context on every session

dec-1768979072186.what: Dual view modes: Columns and Regions
dec-1768979072186.why: Columns view (by type) supports comparison across entity types; Regions view (by domain) shows containment and ownership relationships. Different mental tasks benefit from different spatial organizations.
dec-1768979072186.context: Initial visualization had only column view; users needed different mental models for different tasks
